candidates.title: Brethren, We Have Met To Worship (Hymn 334)

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lines: Brethren, we have met to worship and adore the Lord our God
Will you pray with all your power While
We try to preach the word All
Is vain unless the spirit
Of the Holy One comes down
Brethren, pray and holy manna
Will be showered all around

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lines: Brethren see poor sinners round you some bring
On the brink of war
Death is coming, hell is moving Can
You bear to let them go?
See our fathers and our mothers
And our children sinking down
Brethren, pray and holy manna will be showered all around let
Us love our God supremely

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lines: Let us love each other too
Let us love and pray for sinners till our God makes
All things new
Then He'll call us home to heaven,
At His table we'll sit down
Christ will gird himself and serve us
With sweet manna all around Then
He'll call us home to heaven

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lines: At his table we'll sit down Christ
Will burn himself and serve us
With sweet man all around you
